rooms.name: Central Atrium
rooms.description: The cold water seeps through your shoes as you step into the domed chamber. In the center a silent figure clad in a bright yellow raincoat sits motionless on the edge of a fountain fishing in the dark. Behind the reception desk stands a glitching hologram designed to guide the shoppers.
rooms.hint: The Angler seems to be looking for a bait.

rooms.name: Cinema Lobby
rooms.description: A scent of buttered popcorn teases you. You feel like you've arrived twenty years late for a premiere. The ticket booth is empty and you can't see anything of value around you.
rooms.hint: Why not stop for a snack at the Food Court?

rooms.name: Food Court
rooms.description: You push floating plastic chairs out of your way to get through here. The neon signs above you are barely flashing on the verge of death. Among the debris of a former dining table you spot an Old Pizza Slice.
rooms.hint: You spot an Old Pizza Slice. It could be used as a bait.

rooms.name: Maintenance Hallway
rooms.description: The spinning red emergency lights disorient you, covering your hands in a bloody strobe. Steam hisses from fractured pipes, making it hard to breathe.
rooms.hint: Observe the Cargo Bay for a way to escape.

rooms.name: Electronics Store
rooms.description: You step into the store. It's filled to the ceiling with old CRT televisions, displaying only static and white noise. Wandering through the shop, you find yourself in the Fusion Battery section.
rooms.hint: You find yourself in the Fusion Battery section. The Fusion Battery could be used in a generator.

rooms.name: Arcade
rooms.description: You sink into the sodden carpet. It's darker here, only a few still operational arcade machines cast light that reflects of the sunken floor.
rooms.hint: One does not recommend using the Game Token on these machines if you do not want to get shocked.

rooms.name: Fashion Boutique
rooms.description: You catch movement in your peripheral vision, but it's just your reflection in a shattered mirror. The pale mannequins seem to turn their heads toward you when you look away. The displays are empty, offering nothing of value.
rooms.hint: The displays are empty, offering nothing of value.

rooms.name: Generator Room
rooms.description: You walk through the door marked Authorized Personnl Only. The air here is thick with the taste of copper. A massive generator sits here. It's terrifyingly quiet; a machine this size should be deafening.
rooms.hint: The generator seems to power the Cargo Bay elevator. Find a Fusion Battery to fix it.

rooms.name: Cargo Bay
rooms.description: At final, you find yourself in a large industrial loading zone. Iron chains hanging down like vines. The freight elevator in the center looks like your only ticket out of here, but its control buttons are out of power.
rooms.hint: Its control buttons are out of power. Fix the power source in the Generator Room.

items.name: Old Pizza Slice
items.description: Picking up the Old Pizza Slice, you deduct that it's no longer safe for human consumption.

items.name: Rusty Key
items.description: Observing the Rusty Key, you wonder what it unlocks.

items.name: Fusion Battery
items.description: Taking the Fusion Battery into your hands, you read that it's used for power generators.

items.name: Game Token
items.description: Sliding the Game Token in your pocket, you get the urge to play a game.

dialogues.text: Welcome to the Azure Galleria! We are currently experiencing a minor ▚▜▞▐ humidity anomaly. Please excuse the dampness. I am M.E.I., your Mall Electronic Interactive™. How can I elevate your shopping experience today?

options.label: How do I get out of here?
I need to get into the Maintenance Hallway.
What stores are in this mall?

dialogues.text: Thank you for your visit! Unfortunately, the main escalators are currently ▙▚▛▄ cRUSHed beneath several １０００NaN tons of concrete. Please ask a store personnel to unlock the Cargo Bay elevator. ▚▛▄▙ WARNING: Requested facility power offline!

Access to the Maintenance Sector is strictly prohibited for shoppers. Only authorized personnel with a key may enter. If you require a custodian, please look out for a staff member in the Central Atrium.

options.label: I also wanted to ask... (Go back.)

dialogues.text: We have over fifty luxury retailers! Pursue eternity in fashion at the 'Reiden Boutique'! Experience the grand premiere of Marechaussee d’Focalores' newest cinematic masterpiece, popcorn now with a 5% discount! ...
... Or purchase a brand new TV at 'Haru's Electronics' and get two months of VHS rental for free! (Ads on various shops continue to play...)

The figure in the yellow raincoat slowly turns. A gloved hand emerges to take the pizza slice. The fishing line is cast deep into the dark water. Almost instantly it is reeled back in. Dangling from the hook is a heavy key. The key is unclipped and tossed at your feet.
"The water took the neon in '87," a raspy voice echoes from beneath the hood. "Swallowed the shoppers, the staff... everything. Take the key. Find a way out before the water claims another."

options.label: How do I get out of here?
Is there anyone else down here?
What's wrong with the holographic receptionist?
How do I get out of here?
Is there anyone else down here?
What's wrong with the holographic receptionist?

dialogues.text: A name is just another thing to drown.
A finger of The Angler points towards the dark Maintenance Hallway.
The river broke its banks. Million gallons of water, nowhere to go but down. The neon signs shorted out one by one. Then the screaming stopped.
Alive? You're the only one I've spoken to in decades. So... most likely not.
MEI? Her servers drowned years ago. What you see is just a ghost in the machine, looping the same corporate lies. Don't listen to her cheer. She doesn't know she's dead.
Leave? And go where? The surface is loud. The sun is blinding. Down here, it is quiet, peaceful.
